## HaloBar 0.0.1

The first public build of HaloBar, a floating dock for Windows 11 in the style of Astraeus.

### Highlights
- **A dock instead of a strip.** Your apps, your widgets and your status icons in one floating row; panels grow out of whatever you click.
- **25 widgets, your way.** Weather, system stats, focus timer, clipboard history, notes, to-do, habits, world clock, now playing, the recycle bin and more, picked from a gallery with live previews. Right-click the dock to drag, size and remove them, add dividers, and move the apps anywhere in the row.
- **Everything the Windows taskbar does:** pinned and running apps, window previews, jump lists, the system tray, quick settings, notifications, the calendar and Windows Start. Apps that don't fit wait behind a **+N** tile.
- **Astraeus' themes:** Island, Dark, Light, Glass and Custom. HaloBar leaves the top of the screen to Astraeus and keeps it above the dock.
- **Light on your PC.** Nothing redraws while nothing moves, slow work stays off the drawing thread, and widgets only fetch anything while they're in the dock.
- **Windows' taskbar, one click away.** Settings can hand the taskbar back to Windows; HaloBar waits in the tray until you bring it back.
- **Updates itself.** New versions are checked a few times a day, verified and installed in the background.

> [!NOTE]
> The executable is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may show an "unknown publisher" warning the first time. Click **More info → Run anyway**.
